heading: One team, one consistent brand.
body: We're a compact team that handles multiple creative and digital requirements in one place. Backed by around four years of freelance and professional experience in design, social media, and digital marketing before founding Social Beelines in 2024, we focus on keeping your brand and social presence consistent — with services customized to what your business actually needs.
panelHeadline: "A beeline is the shortest path to the flower — we keep your brand moving in one clear direction."
